outcomes: putnami cloud secrets set stores a secret under the config key the application reads, and warns when the published schema does not declare that key
nonGoals: Finding secrets already stored under a former snake_case requirement name, such as crm.api_key. putnami cloud secrets delete removes one

requirements.text: putnami cloud secrets set stores, with no warning, a key that the published schema declares: a field, an object, a field of an object, or an entry of a map or of an object without declared fields, including in a config block whose path has several segments.

A key that the published schema does not declare is stored, and a warning naming the putnami cloud config show --secret-keys command prints after the write succeeds. When the schema read fails for any reason other than a 404, the key is stored and a warning says it was stored unchecked. A failed write prints no warning.
